[P2] Correct the diagnostic's checkpointing claim

A completed child context can checkpoint its result without any nested operations. With default configuration and a small result, `executeChildContext` checkpoints the serialized return value, and `handleCompletedChildContext` returns it without calling the body again. Thus `runInChildContext(async () => 42)` does not run again on every replay as this diagnostic claims. Keep the best-practice suggestion, but remove the unconditional checkpoint/re-execution claim from the diagnostic and accompanying new documentation; explain the relevant virtual-context and `ReplayChildren` cases accurately.
